name: herdr-development-skills
description: Integration layer between Herdr and the development-skills plugins: checks which plugins and features are enabled and configured, then runs spec-workflow tasks and build-loop lanes in Herdr worktree agents an orchestrator listens to, and peer reviews next to a lane. Requires the herdr and herdr-simple-orchestrate plugins.

interface.shortDescription: Run board tasks and build-loop lanes in Herdr worktree agents.
interface.longDescription: Connects Herdr to the development-skills plugins. It detects which plugins and features are enabled and configured in the current repository, then runs a spec-workflow task, the build loop, or several parallel build lanes in Herdr worktree agents while an orchestrator listens and relays their questions. Requires the herdr and herdr-simple-orchestrate plugins; each integration is offered only when its specialized plugin is present and configured.
defaultPrompt: Which Herdr integrations can run in this repository?
Run board issue 123 in a Herdr worktree agent.
Run three build lanes in Herdr worktrees.
